recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-40433 decision in active core source while preserving the intended lower-strength discouragement in the implementation note; no further core source work is indicated for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-40433 was Published with a Persuasive R5 vocabulary resolution asking the implicit ValueSet and ConceptMap notes to stop saying implementers SHOULD NOT create explicit resources whose canonical URI matches a known implicit value set or concept map. The approved replacement says such explicit resources SHALL conform to the implicit definition pattern, server handling is discretionary, and an implementation note should only discourage local explicit resources when the relevant server already supports the implicit form.
initial_application: Earlier Published R5 clarifications FHIR-39255 and FHIR-39266 introduced the ValueSet and ConceptMap SHOULD NOT creation wording. Commit 9f780149387dc652bec02aa7744e52774acddbc9 added the FHIR-40433 replacement text and implementation notes to both source pages and removed the old ConceptMap paragraph, but left the old ValueSet SHOULD NOT paragraph after the new implementation note.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists valueset=ValueSet and conceptmap=ConceptMap under [resources], so the notes are in current build scope. The current ConceptMap note already matches the FHIR-40433 direction. VOC 2023-02-20 minutes record FHIR-40433 as resolved, and the community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published one source-changing commit that removes only the obsolete ValueSet SHOULD NOT paragraph from source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml, leaving the replacement SHALL-conform text, server discretion text, implementation note, and already-correct ConceptMap note unchanged.
source_changes: source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml: removed the stale paragraph saying implementers SHOULD NOT create ValueSet resources where ValueSet.url matches a known implicit value-set pattern.
